### A King and His Queen
Author: Shirley M. Dobson
Site: Bible Gateway
URL: https://www.biblegateway.com/devotionals/night-light-couples/today
Passage: 1 Samuel 2:30
Points:
- Queen Esther exemplifies the principle of honor through her deferential, patient approach toward King Xerxes.
- Rather than barging in or making immediate demands, she showed deep respect and humility toward her husband.
- Because she honored the king, Xerxes honored her in return and spared her people.
- Although human nature tends to criticize marital flaws, treating a spouse with dignity fosters mutual respect.
- Choosing to honor your spouse cultivates a more loving, peaceful, and joyful home.

### Time with God - August 23
Author: Time with God
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/timewithgod/time-with-god-august-23.html
Passage: 1 Samuel 2:30
Points:
- God graciously extends the promise of His blessing to anyone willing to place Him first.
- Human hearts are prone to drift away into self-centeredness even after experiencing God's goodness.
- Straying from the Lord causes believers to forfeit the peace, closeness, and purpose found in His presence.
- Turning back from worldly pursuits restores fellowship and the experience of God's honor.
